# Hye Vem

Vem Data is an independently consumable browser/React knowledge runtime. These documents describe the current source, not a release promise.

- [Hye Vem](https://hyevem.com/docs/): Shared foundations for browser applications, with packages you can adopt independently.
- [Vem Data](https://hyevem.com/docs/data): Describe the information and operations a feature needs. Let shared infrastructure coordinate them.
- [Start here](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/start): Understand the fit, then learn through a small application.
- [What Vem Data does](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/start/overview): Keep related views up to date without coordinating them in every component.
- [Explore the task board](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/start/quickstart): Filter a list, finish a task, and keep an edit safe.
- [Four concepts](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/start/concepts): Connect the task-board interactions to the code you write.
- [Build with Vem](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/build): Recipes for screens, actions, editors, and tests.
- [Display data](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/build/display): Add a list, column, filter, or detail view through a typed query.
- [Partial rows and honest empty states](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/build/partial-results): Keep useful content visible when some information is missing.
- [Commands, progress, and outcomes](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/build/actions): Add an action button and show what happened.
- [Build a protected editor](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/build/editors): Keep a draft safe while the saved value or permissions change.
- [Use Vem outside React](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/build/imperative): Read, observe, and run commands through the same descriptions.
- [Test a feature and its states](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/build/testing): Supply data and outcomes without a worker or a backend.
- [Connect your data](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/connect): Give Vem your backend rules once; keep feature code small.
- [Connect a resource](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/connect/resources): Teach Vem how your backend supplies one kind of data.
- [Apply events and derive values](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/connect/events): Update shared information from what the backend actually tells you.
- [Implement commands and edits](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/connect/commands-edits): Turn a feature's intent into an operation with an honest outcome.
- [Connect permissions](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/connect/access): Declare who may read or write; inherit the evidence instead of tracking it in screens.
- [Configure the browser host](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/connect/browser-host): Connect a React app and its tabs to one shared owner.
- [Keep progress visible after navigation](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/connect/feedback): Wire inline progress and shared notices once in the application shell.
- [How Vem chooses reads](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/connect/planning): Declare backend capabilities; Vem plans across the whole outstanding demand.
- [Inspect consumers and try UI scenarios](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/connect/devtools): Connect development tools to the same public contract your features use.
- [Observe a server operation](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/connect/operations): Follow accepted work and recover without accidentally submitting it twice.
- [Understand Vem](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/understand): Follow the evidence behind acquisition, access, and recovery.
- [When Vem reads from the service](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/understand/acquisition): Reuse known information and acquire only what a view still needs.
- [Why information disappears after an access change](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/understand/access): Keep readable information and forget only what lost its permission.
- [What happens when the app closes mid-operation](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/understand/recovery): Keep accepted work separate from what the UI knows about it.
- [Reference and troubleshooting](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference): Find an exact contract or diagnose a specific symptom.
- [API map](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api-map): Choose the public import for the responsibility you own.
- [Troubleshooting](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/troubleshooting): Start with what you see, then check the responsible layer.
- [Maintainer map](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/maintainer-map): Trace a documented behavior to implementation and focused tests.
- [Integration limits](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/limits): Know which guarantees your backend and browser host must provide.
- [Contribute to these docs](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/contributing): Keep guides, examples, reference, and exports in sync.
- [Vem Data API](https://hyevem.com/docs/data/reference/api): Generated from the public package entry points. Types and signatures follow the installed source.
